_note: Antigravity tool names used in generated agent files. Source: antigravity.google/docs/subagents and /docs/hooks (checked 2026-11-20). The docs warn that a misspelled or unmapped tool name can hang a subagent: after `sat init`, open each agent once in Antigravity. If your Antigravity version names a tool differently, edit this map in the SAT repository (not in a project) and run `sat update`.
